PlussQit API Reference¶

Back to PlussQit

PlussQit’s method surface is documented across a set of focused design and reference notes. This page is the curated entry point into them.

Method surface¶

  • Series API Reference: the per-method reference for Series — one page per method, with real, verified examples. The primary entry point; start here.

  • Series Factory API Reference: the separate handwritten construction reference for pluss::series::* — shape-first allocators, value-first constructors, range builders, and the broader Series factory surface.

  • Note API Reference: the handwritten per-method reference for Note — the vectorized text object for cleanup, tokenization, regex work, NLP-style text preprocessing, and TeX-aware transforms.

  • Note Factory API Reference: the separate handwritten construction reference for pluss::note::* — text and bytes constructors, shape-first and like-factories, generative builders, and text-splitting and assembly factories.

  • TokenBatch API Reference: the closed ragged text result returned by tokenizers and extractors, including flat token storage, row offsets, state, and ownership.

  • Timeline API Reference: the handwritten per-method reference for Timeline — the general temporal payload for scalar, vector, and N-D time data.

  • Timeline Factory API Reference: construction, ranges, sampling, selection, and rendering in pluss::timeline.

  • Duration API Reference: the handwritten per-method reference for Duration — the elapsed-time counterpart to Timeline, for Timeline - Timeline results and Timeline ± Duration arithmetic.

  • TimeIndex API Reference: the handwritten per-method reference for TimeIndex — the 1D temporal axis object for search, slicing, resampling, rolling windows, and alignment.

  • Series Methods: the naming-philosophy note (method-first vs. free functions, pile/unite naming deviations).

  • Method Index: a flat cross-referenced index of the whole surface, documented and not-yet-documented alike.

  • Reductions: sum/mean/min/max/std and related reduction behavior.

  • Statistics: statistical operations available on Series.

Type system and semantics¶

  • API Philosophy: the design principles the whole surface follows.

  • Type Promotion: how mixed-dtype operations resolve a result type.

  • Broadcasting: shape-compatibility rules for elementwise operations.

  • NaN / Inf: how missing and non-finite values are represented and handled.

  • Complex, Float8: specialized scalar type support.

Indexing and shape¶

  • Indexing Parity, Indexing / Scatter: how element access and scatter-style writes behave.

  • Reshape and Views, View Invariants: what a reshape or view does and does not guarantee.

  • Scatter, Scatter/Reduce: scatter-with-reduction operations.

Construction and configuration¶

  • Factories, Factories / Config: how Series and related objects are constructed.

  • Config: library-wide configuration knobs.

  • Ownership: value/reference ownership semantics.

Errors¶

  • Error Handling: the exception and error-reporting model.

  • Errors / Stack Trace: diagnostic context attached to errors.

Everything else¶

Every other .md file in this folder (design notes, patch logs, roadmap tracking) is still reachable from the documentation map and searchable from this site’s search box, even though it isn’t singled out above.
